Container.Name: accounts-balance-tracker
Container.Overview: Self-hosted tracker of your accounts balances over time: bank, savings, investment, pension, crypto, cash and loans. Record each account's balance whenever you want and see the total and its evolution in charts. CSV import/export, optional login with one-time codes. SQLite by default, PostgreSQL optional.

Config.Name: Default currency
Config.Description: Currency for new accounts and for the total of all currencies (ISO 4217 code: EUR, USD, GBP...)

Config.Name: Login user
Config.Description: User for the login screen. Set it together with the password; leave both empty for no login

Config.Name: Login password
Config.Description: Password for the login screen. Changing it logs everyone out

Config.Name: Login one-time code (OTP)
Config.Description: true = also ask for a code from an authenticator app. The first login shows a QR code to add it; to show a new one, delete .totp_secret in the Data folder

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id the app runs as

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id the app runs as

Config.Name: Trusted proxies
Config.Description: IPs or CIDR ranges of the reverse proxies whose X-Forwarded-For header is trusted (the real client IP). Default: local and Docker networks. Set your proxy's IP to be stricter
